notes.title: Game Released
notes.content:
Jump Scare Slayer has been released.

First explore the creepy mansion while escaping from enemies, find the legendary sword, and then slash away at monsters!!

There are two game modes: "Prologue" and "Slayer Mode". To play Slayer Mode, you need to clear the prologue

(But actually, if you do something, you can play it without clearing the prologue)
